questions.stem: What is the difference between magnification and resolution in microscopy?

options.text: Magnification is how clear the image is; resolution is how large it appears
Magnification is how large the image appears; resolution is the ability to distinguish fine detail
They mean exactly the same thing
Magnification only applies to electron microscopes; resolution only applies to light microscopes

questions.explanation: Magnification refers to how many times larger the image appears compared to the actual object, while resolution is the ability to distinguish between two points that are very close together - it determines the clarity and detail of the image.
